steps: Download registration certificates for all GSTINs
Check every place of business is included
items.text: All places of business registered; GSTIN status active; additional places updated.

steps: Prepare month-wise outward supplies from books
items.text: Outward supplies in books reconciled month-wise with GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B.

steps: Reconcile ITC in books with GSTR-2B
items.text: ITC claimed is supported by tax invoices, goods or services received, and appears in GSTR-2B.

steps: Check invoice dates of ITC claimed late
items.text: ITC claimed within the time limit (30 November following the financial year or annual return, whichever is earlier).

steps: Check reversal and interest; check re-availment on payment
items.text: ITC reversed with interest where supplier not paid within 180 days of invoice; re-availed on payment.

steps: Identify credits needing reversal under Rule 37A
items.text: ITC reversed where supplier has not filed GSTR-3B for the period by the due date.

items.how: Expense ledger scan for blocked categories.
steps: Scan expense ledgers for blocked categories
Quantify and report any wrong claim
items.text: Blocked credits not claimed: motor vehicles, food and beverages, club membership, gifts, personal use, works contracts for immovable property.
Common ITC reversed proportionately for exempt and non-business supplies.

steps: List expenses under notified RCM services and imports of services
Check tax paid in cash and self-invoices
Check credit taken in the right period
items.text: Reverse charge paid in cash on notified services (GTA, advocates, security, director services, sponsorship, renting by unregistered persons) and import of services; self-invoices raised.

items.how: State code of party vs tax ledger.
steps: Compare party state code with the tax ledger used
List CGST/SGST on inter-state supplies and IGST on intra-state
items.text: IGST vs CGST/SGST charged correctly based on place of supply; no CGST/SGST on inter-state parties.
E-invoice (IRN) generated for all B2B invoices where turnover crosses the threshold.

steps: Match with despatches above the threshold
items.text: E-way bills generated for movement of goods above the threshold.

steps: Check issue within the time limit
items.text: Credit and debit notes issued within time and declared in returns.
Tax paid on advances received for services.
Interest on delayed tax payment and late fees paid.

steps: Select a sample of main products / services
items.text: HSN/SAC codes and tax rates applied correctly on main products and services.

steps: List supplies between related / distinct persons
items.text: Supplies between related or distinct persons valued correctly (including cross-charge between branches).

steps: Reconcile turnover and tax with audited accounts
items.text: GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C filed; turnover and tax reconciled with audited financial statements.

steps: Download notices and orders from the GST portal
items.text: Notices, show-cause notices and demand orders listed and provided or disclosed.

steps: Check LUT filing for zero-rated supplies
items.text: LUT filed for zero-rated supplies; refunds claimed and tracked.
GST TDS / TCS credits accepted and reconciled.
